marks.gloss_en: דכתיב: ביום ההוא יגדל המספד ... כמספד הדדרמון בבקעת מגדון (Zech 12:11)
of the Torah -- the matter is explicit [so its Targum revealed nothing hidden]
ואמר רב יוסף: אלמלא תרגומא דהאי קרא לא ידענא מאי קאמר
Rav Yosef: were it not for the Targum of this verse, I would not know what it says
שמע מינה -- from Daniel's companions, frightened because their mazal saw
Ravina: learn from this -- one who is frightened, though he himself sees nothing, his mazal sees
אין, מהוה הוו ... ואתו צופים ותקינו -- the forms existed; the Seers fixed which is medial and which final (= p_tzofim_kavu_mekomot)
אין, מהוה הוו -- yes, both forms existed; only their placement was unknown (= p_tzofim_kavu_mekomot)
yes, they existed, but it was not known which belongs in the middle of a word and which at the end; the Seers came and established open forms medially and closed forms finally
סוף סוף אלה המצות -- even fixing their places is innovating
אלא שכחום וחזרו ויסדום (= p_shchachum_mantzepach)
rather, they forgot them, and [the Seers] re-established them
ותרגום של תורה אונקלוס אמרו? והא אמר רב ... מפורש זה תרגום -- the Targum existed in Ezra's day
Rav: 'and they read in the book, the Torah of God' (Neh 8:8) -- this is the scriptural text
שכחום וחזרו ויסדום (= p_shchachum_targum)
Rav: 'and they gave the sense' -- these are the verse divisions
the Targum of the Torah -- Onkelos the convert said it from the mouth of R' Eliezer and R' Yehoshua
Yonatan ben Uzziel: I revealed Your secrets -- not for my honour nor my father's house, but for Yours, so that disputes not multiply in Israel
and he sought further to reveal a Targum of the Writings
who are 'the men who were with me' (Dan 10:7)? Chaggai, Zechariah and Malachi
they were greater than he, for they were prophets and he was not a prophet
since they did not see, why were they frightened? though they did not see, their mazal saw
if service, which is weighty, is cancelled for the Megilla, Torah study all the more so
תניא נמי הכי: כהנים בעבודתן ... כולן מבטלין עבודתן
מכאן סמכו -- the house of Rabbi relied on this baraita for Torah study, by the KV kv_tt_meavodah
the baraita: priests, Levites and Israelites at their posts all cancel their service to hear the Megilla

ועבודה חמורה מתלמוד תורה? והכתיב ... וישתחו (Josh 5:13-14), the angel's עתה באתי, and Rav Shmuel bar Unya: גדול תלמוד תורה יותר מהקרבת תמידין, שנאמר עתה באתי (3b.1 = p_rsbu_gadol_tt) -- the KV's premise that service outweighs Torah study is false
the verse (Josh 5:13-14): Joshua saw a man standing before him ... and bowed down
דאמר רב יהודה אמר רב -- Rav's dictum, adduced for R' Yosei bar Chanina's (no SupportKind for an amoraic precedent; svara as corpus convention)
Rav: priests at their service, Levites on their platform and Israelites at their maamad -- all cancel their service and come to hear the Megilla
והיכי עביד הכי? והאמר רבי יהושע בן לוי: אסור לאדם שיתן שלום לחבירו בלילה, חיישינן שמא שד הוא -- how could Joshua bow to an unknown figure at night?
שאני התם דאמר ליה: כי אני שר צבא ה' (= p_shani_sar_tzava)
RYbL: one may not greet his fellow at night -- we are concerned it may be a demon
ודלמא משקרי? -- perhaps it was a demon lying
גמירי דלא מפקי שם שמים לבטלה -- it is a tradition that they do not utter Heaven's name in vain
R' Yosei bar Chanina: priestly and Levitical families cancel their service and come to hear the reading of the Megilla
the angel: last evening you neglected the afternoon tamid, and now you have neglected Torah study
